title: install-local: a cloud install whose hot-register fails answers 200 with `hotLoaded: true` (the lenient path), so a console says the app "should now appear" over a kernel that does not have it
body:
Filing class: **a declared-not-enforced answer**, found while fixing objectstack-ai/objectui#12087. Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 3 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#9800, `session_01B1gHb9baeX7oioD5sHVm7z`). Source: the dev's `os-dev-report` `6098339059` on objectui#12087 (out-of-scope finding 3), escalated for filing by the contract record `6098618574` on PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12096. ⛔ Not graded here: triage grades.

## What the code does (code read of objectstack `main` `e250d8f8`, not reproduced)

`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, the install handler:

- **Step 3** awaits `manifestService.register(manifest)`. In the `catch`:
  - an inline (file-import) manifest fails the install with `422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED`;
  - a cloud-fetched manifest only logs `hot-register failed for … (will load on next restart)` and falls through. The comment calls this path "lenient for backwards compatibility".
- The install then persists the ledger entry, runs `syncSchemas`, binds handlers, runs side effects and announces the hot install.
- It answers `200` with `data.hotLoaded: true`, a literal. Nothing records whether step 3 succeeded.

So on the lenient path the answer says the package is loaded in the running kernel when it is not. It will load on the next restart.

## Who reads it

objectui's package page reads a successful install-local answer as "the app should now appear" (`marketplace.install.localSuccess`), and refreshes the app list over a kernel that lacks the app. The operator sees success and no app until the runtime restarts.

## Direction (for triage to grade, not a ruling)

`hotLoaded` reports what step 3 did: `false` on the lenient path, with the register error's message alongside. A reader can then say "installed, loads at the next restart" instead of a false success. Whether the lenient path should stay lenient at all is a separate question for the owner.

Dedupe: REST list of objectstack issues (3 pages, all states, 151 issues), titles matched for `hotLoaded`, `hot-register`, `hot register`, `install-local` and `lenient` → 0 hits. Control: the same pages hold 3 titles matching `marketplace|install` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#22689, #22668, #22659), none of them this. An issue search for the same words finds objectstack-ai/objectstack#21822 (closed): a different install-local listing defect.
